title: Make reproduction idempotency strategy explicit
notes: Added idempotency_strategy support to ScenarioEvent ('fresh_attempt' vs 'reuse_same_key') and reproduction_strategy to BugReport.

QAController._handle_anomaly explicitly chooses between fresh idempotency keys (fresh_attempt) vs preserving identical keys (reuse_same_key) for IDEMPOTENCY / cached operations during recheck reproduction.
